'''Quisun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], where he tasked Imperial forces with recovering a set of walker plans stolen by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after the Republic agents' ship crashed on the [[Sundari Flatlands]].<ref name="TOR" />
